text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
To think my shoelace would suddenly 
snap... Well, I bought new ones, so I need 
to get back to training right away!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
What should I do, I have no idea...! All I 
need to do is go down, so, uhm... Aah~, 
and Trainer is waiting for me, too...!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
—And because of that, I couldn't really 
come outside... I'm sorry...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Buena Vista missed training because she 
got lost. Even if unintentional, you 
caution her to contact you sooner next 
time.
